text:
Priya (Product): quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. folks asked for short, actionable dates for: API streaming/backpressure, per-route Console metrics, and Optimize auto-quant recommendations. can leadership give concise targets so teams can plan? :spiral_calendar:

Alex (CTO): short targets: streaming/backpressure internal beta ~2024-07-22, public beta mid-August. Console per-route metrics: hosted beta late-August, Dedicated visibility in November. Optimize auto-quant recommendations: experimental alpha Sept (Q3), broader beta Oct, GA aimed for Dec (Q4). subject to pilot findings and infra risks.

Sam (PM): added detail: streaming work focuses on KV cache reuse + adaptive batching; goal ~=20-30% p95 improvement for typical multi-turn chat. priority routing (route->lane) is coupled but may be piloted separately in early Q3.

Jordan (Eng): engineering caveat: priority lanes touch scheduler, autoscaler, and cache eviction. two risk areas: node churn under heavy prefix caching and cross-tenant memory isolation. if stress tests regress we may slip pilot by 2-3 weeks. we'll post test results in eng-runtime.

Elena (Support): request: we need migration/runbook templates and SDK warnings before beta flips. support needs rollback steps and customer comms.

Priya (Product): agreed. plan: SDK warnings (30/60 day cadence), per-route opt-in toggles in Console, and a one-click rollback for route-level changes. Support and Solutions will coordinate customer comms.

Kai (CEO): reminder: anything affecting Dedicated latency SLAs must have conservative canaries and automatic fallback. prioritize observability and speedy rollback.

Alex (CTO): will publish a short timeline doc with caveats and pilot sign-ups by EOD. ping me if you want access to the pilot cohort. :+1:

Priya (Product): thanks — i'll add an FAQ to the Console roadmap card once Alex posts the doc. follow-ups welcome in-thread or DM @Sam/@Jordan. :raised_hands:
